ladders.title: Network resilience — class-C DRS 3→5
ladders.summary: A synthetic, no-spoof network-bench ladder (UDP amplification shapes + TCP connection pressure), escalating DRS 3→5. The class-C companion to an L7 playbook: run on the isolated bench, its verdicts feed the WRS read-only. No real reflector, no spoofing.
